text:
maria: putting together a focused rollout plan for tenant-scoped fallback (compact model) — asking eng, sre, cs for tradeoffs and owners. Goal: let pilot customers opt-in, run internal canary, then stage regionally with automated degrade on SLO/quality issues.

maria: problem statement: some customers want predictable behavior and lower cost during peaks. we need a safe way to route traffic to a smaller model variant automatically when latency or quality regressions hit thresholds.

samir: infra notes: we can evaluate per-request tenant flags in the router. suggest header x-rw-tenant-fallback. routing table supports weighted splits and per-tenant overrides. rough effort: ~3w to add flag eval + routing, 1w for telemetry. CPU delta for compact variant ~25-35%.

devon: SRE checklist: must have an automated circuit breaker with hysteresis. trigger if p95/p99 latency > 2x SLO for 10m OR error-rate increases by 3x. when tripped, flip affected traffic to compact variant and notify on-call + PO. suggest ramp plan: 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 100% with 24h holds; auto-rollback if error budget burned or quality metric regresses. add synthetic prompt probing during canary to surface hallucination / embedding drift.

lea: CS/pilot asks: two customers interested (FinSys, MediSure). must be able to opt in per tenant and have a console-level kill-switch. MediSure requires EU-only processing for pilot. they also want a clear note that embeddings/outputs might differ under fallback.

carl: eng-platform can allocate an isolated EU pool for MediSure. estimate 6 business days to provision and wire routing. will add tenant-scoped logs so CS can inspect request/response pairs.

samir: proposed flag config (example):
```
{
  "flag": "tenant_compact_fallback_2026",
  "variants": ["primary-2026-01","compact-2026-01"],
  "stages": [
    {"name":"internal-canary","pct":0.5},
    {"name":"pilot-optin","pct":5},
    {"name":"regional-stage","pct":10}
  ],
  "per_tenant_override": true
}
```
Note: runtime needs a hook to shadow outputs for A/B diffing and quality scoring.

devon: runbook quick steps:
- detection: if p99 > threshold OR error spike -> evaluate per-region fallback decision.
- action: set routing weight = 100% compact for affected region/tenant.
- escalation: page on-call + product owner.
- postmortem: capture sample prompts, outputs, cost delta, and quality-check results.
Telemetry to capture: token-level cost diff, latency percentiles, quality regression score (BLEU-ish / embedding-similarity) and error types.

maria: legal/data: Lea coordinate with legal about MediSure EU residency. we need proof that requests/logs remain in EU pool. Also confirm retention window.

lea: I'll collect pilot prompt sets from FinSys and MediSure this week. will get legal looped for data residency. pilot onboarding timeline depends on EU pool readiness.

samir: if we need to trim scope: skip the regional-stage pct=10 step and run only internal-canary + pilot-optin. reduces infra+SRE surface.

devon: agree narrower scope first run. synthetic checks + opt-in minimize risk.

maria: decision checklist:
- [ ] runtime flag + per-request routing (samir)
- [ ] EU pool provisioned (carl)
- [ ] SRE runbook + automated rollback (devon)
- [ ] pilot prompts collected + customers signed (lea)
- [ ] legal signoff for EU data handling (lea/legal)

maria: owners: samir (runtime & flags), carl (infra/pool), devon (SRE/runbook & alerts), lea (customer onboarding & legal).

maria: proposed milestones: internal canary in 1 week (0.5%), pilot cohort in 3 weeks, optional regional stage after pilot validation. sync Friday 11am to confirm RFCs and timelines.

lea: customers prefer opt-in initial approach. I'll push that as default in onboarding.

samir: I'll open RFC with the flag spec and runtime hook for shadowing.

carl: will start EU pool provisioning today, update ETA in #eng-infra.

devon: I'll draft the runbook and pager rules; will include synthetic prompt set and automatic rollback thresholds.

maria: thanks all — I'll update the roadmap ticket and create the feature-flag PR template. next sync Friday 11am. :rocket:
